notes.title: Arena Renovator full release!

The day has come![/h3] 🏆🏆🏆

[previewyoutube=XCQ65yTU274;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Today is our BIG DAY we've been waiting for! - full release of Arena Renovation![/b]

[h3][b][u]To celebrate the premiere, we have a surprise for you and it is BIG, a football stadium![/u][/b]

[*]many [b]new types of rooms:[/b] VIP, Conference, Lectures, Restaurant
[*]many [b]bug fixes![/b][/list]
